title: Taiwan morning brief research pack — price first, actual flows separated
methodology: Observed prices and primary/dated flow records are evidence; news narratives are possible explanations, not proof of flows.
Crypto prices use the Yahoo Finance one-minute bar stamped exactly 2026-10-07 02:23 UTC and the corresponding minute 24 hours earlier.
Gold and dollar prices use the completed October 6 US session; the latest independently reported Asia-morning dollar print is also shown.
October 6 US spot-crypto ETF totals were incomplete at the editorial cutoff, so the latest completed actual-flow date, October 5, is used and the incomplete date is explicitly excluded.
No X/Twitter claim is used. Taiwan implications are analyst inference and are labeled as such.

gold.price_read: Gold advanced while the US dollar and Treasury yields eased. This is a price observation; the cited safe-haven and rate narratives are explanations, not flow proof.

actual_flow.metric: global physically backed gold ETF net inflow
actual_flow.source: World Gold Council Weekly Markets Monitor
actual_flow.frequency_note: Monthly actual-flow figure; no verified complete global daily flow for October 6 was available by cutoff.

gold.taiwan_implication: Higher gold alongside lower yields is mildly supportive for defensive/precious-metal positioning, but it is not a standalone risk-off signal because US equities simultaneously set records. Avoid treating the monthly ETF inflow as an October 6 daily flow.

usd.price_read: The dollar gave back part of the prior risk/fiscal premium as European bond stress eased and immediate Fed-hike odds fell, though DXY remained above 101.

actual_flow_proxy.metric: US money market fund total net assets
actual_flow_proxy.source: Investment Company Institute weekly money market fund assets
actual_flow_proxy.limitation: This is a verified USD-liquidity/cash-vehicle asset flow proxy, not a daily DXY flow measure.

usd.taiwan_implication: A softer overnight dollar can ease immediate TWD pressure and help foreign-risk appetite, but Fed minutes and US yields remain the decisive confirmation. Do not infer Taiwan foreign buying from DXY alone.

price.source: US Treasury daily par yield curve, October 5 versus October 6

actual_flow.interpretation: Actual auction demand was orderly, with a 2.62 bid-to-cover ratio, after September's weak auctions had raised concern.

additional_demand_context.comparison: 823 billion for full-year 2025 and 840 billion for full-year 2024
additional_demand_context.source: TD Securities data reported by Reuters on 2026-10-06
additional_demand_context.limitation: Reuters-reported institutional data, not a primary daily Treasury transaction series.

us_treasuries.taiwan_implication: The one-day yield decline supports long-duration technology valuations, but 10-year and 30-year yields remain high at 5.27% and 5.64%. Taiwan growth stocks may get a tactical valuation tailwind, not an all-clear; upcoming 10-year/30-year auctions and Fed minutes are the next tests.

actual_etf_flow.cutoff_status: October 6 table was still incomplete at cutoff and is not treated as final.

bitcoin.read: BTC sold off into the Taiwan morning, but its latest five completed ETF sessions were still net positive despite October 5 outflows. Price weakness and medium-window ETF demand therefore diverged.

actual_etf_flow.cutoff_status: October 6 table was still incomplete at cutoff and is not treated as final.

ethereum.read: ETH fell more than BTC and its ETF flow record was weaker: five consecutive completed sessions through October 5 summed to a 206.0 million dollar outflow.

eth_btc.read: ETH underperformed BTC over 24 hours. The relative-price move agrees with the weaker completed ETH ETF-flow trend, but it does not prove causality.

risk_tape.source: Reuters close report; Yahoo Finance for SOX and VIX closes

material_verified_news.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq set record closing highs as yields eased and AI-linked shares advanced
verified_facts: S&P 500 rose 0.58% to 7,818.93 and Nasdaq rose 0.45% to 27,599.79.
Marvell gained 5.8% after lifting its fiscal-2028 revenue forecast to about 20 billion dollars; it projected fiscal-2029 custom-chip revenue of at least 12 billion dollars.
AMD gained 2.8% after management said 2027 chip supply would be increased substantially.
material_verified_news.taiwan_implication: Positive demand read-through for Taiwan foundry, advanced packaging, substrate, networking and server-ODM groups. Keep it sector-level: the evidence does not establish supplier-specific order wins.

material_verified_news.headline: Google signed a 3,590-MW power arrangement with Constellation Energy
verified_facts: The arrangement includes a 20-year PPA for 890 MW from upgraded nuclear plants and a 15-year supply agreement for 2,700 MW in PJM.
Constellation plans more than 4.3 billion dollars of fleet investment; first upgraded-plant delivery is expected in 2028.
Constellation shares rose 12.3% in the completed US session.
material_verified_news.taiwan_implication: Confirms power availability as a binding AI-data-center constraint. Supports the long-cycle case for Taiwan server power, thermal-management and electrical-equipment suppliers, while also warning that grid limits can delay deployments and raise customer capex.

material_verified_news.headline: US August imports reached a record as AI-related capital-goods demand stayed strong
verified_facts: The US trade deficit widened 13.7% to 105.6 billion dollars, above the 102.0 billion dollar Reuters consensus.
Imports rose 4.3% to a record 420.8 billion dollars.
Capital-goods imports rose 6.2 billion dollars to a record 146.4 billion dollars, driven by semiconductors and industrial machinery.
The US maintained a goods deficit with Taiwan.
material_verified_news.taiwan_implication: Near-term evidence of firm US demand for semiconductors and AI equipment is export-positive for Taiwan. The persistent bilateral deficit also raises medium-term tariff and trade-policy scrutiny; strong demand and political risk should be tracked together.

material_verified_news.headline: Treasury demand cleared the 3-year auction, but short-end structural demand has slowed
verified_facts: The Treasury sold 58 billion dollars of 3-year notes at a 4.932% high yield with a 2.62 bid-to-cover ratio.
Money-market-fund inflows totaled 158 billion dollars in the first three quarters of 2026, sharply below 823 billion dollars in full-year 2025, according to TD Securities data reported by Reuters.
Barclays estimated 225 billion dollars of bill issuance in October and 160 billion dollars in November.
material_verified_news.taiwan_implication: The auction reduces immediate tail-risk after September's weak sales, but heavy supply and slower money-fund inflows can keep global discount rates elevated. Taiwan's long-duration technology leadership remains sensitive to US auction quality and Fed communication.

taiwan_open_framework.base_case: Constructive but rate-sensitive: US record closes, a stronger AI capex read-through, lower Treasury yields and a softer dollar favor Taiwan technology at the open.
counterweights: Crypto risk appetite deteriorated sharply into 10:23 Taipei, with ETH underperforming BTC and completed ETH ETF flows persistently negative.
US 10-year and 30-year yields remain historically high despite the overnight decline.
Record US imports validate demand but can intensify tariff and bilateral-trade scrutiny.
October 6 crypto ETF flows were not final by cutoff; do not use preliminary table totals as settled evidence.
confirmation_checks_after_open: TWD direction and verified foreign institutional net buying/selling in Taiwan equities
TAIEX semiconductor breadth rather than index-only strength
US 10-year yield reaction ahead of the next Treasury auction
Final October 6 Farside spot-BTC and spot-ETH ETF tables
Fed September meeting minutes due later October 7

data_gaps: No verified complete October 6 US spot-Bitcoin or spot-Ethereum ETF total was available at the 10:23 Taipei cutoff; October 5 is the latest completed date.
No complete global daily gold-ETF flow for October 6 was verified; the latest WGC actual-flow evidence is monthly September data published October 5.
A daily transaction-flow measure for DXY does not exist in the cited public sources; ICI money-market-fund net assets are used only as a dated USD-liquidity proxy.
No Taiwan cash-market foreign institutional flow is included because the Taiwan session had not yet completed at the morning cutoff.
